request.query: Multivariate Hasse derivative commutes with coefficient change by a ring homomorphism

items.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S) (k : ℕ),
  (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] (Polynomial.map f p) = Polynomial.map f ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p)

items.name: Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S),
  Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp (Polynomial.map f p) =
    Finsupp.mapRange (fun x => Polynomial.map f x) ⋯ (Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp p)
